abstract: This paper examines the effect of Brazil's Family Health Program (Programa Saude da Familia, FHP) on cognitive skills (measured by test scores) of fifth‐grade students. We use biennial data from national exams between 2007 and 2015, and variation in the FHP implementation date across municipalities, birth cohort, and test year to identify the effect of the program on language and mathematics test scores. In municipalities in the North and Northeast regions, students exposed to FHP at or before birth score 0.72 points higher in language and 0.98 points higher in mathematics than those first exposed later, corresponding to 0.0194 sd and 0.0259 sd in intent‐to‐treat estimates. We further show that early exposure to FHP is associated with improvements in test scores in municipalities with lower income and limited access to basic public health infrastructure, such as access to running water and sewage, providing further evidence that the program benefitted economically disadvantaged municipalities the most. Heterogeneity analyses reveal no significant differences by student gender or mother's education, but important differences by race, as the program effects are concentrated among mixed‐race and Black students. Our findings are consistent with health‐related channels playing an important role, rather than measured parental engagement, although the precise mechanisms cannot be directly identified with the available data.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: The Effect of Brazil's Family Health Program on Cognitive Skills
title_zh: 巴西家庭健康计划对认知技能的影响

abstract: This study examines the role of the accounting quality of U.S. federal agencies, measured with audit opinions, in federal budget allocations to those agencies. We find that, when an agency receives a modified audit opinion, the president proposes and Congress enacts a lower budget for the agency, and the budgetary disagreement between them increases. These effects strengthen when the president and Congress have stronger incentives to demonstrate spending accountability to taxpayers. Exploiting the enactment of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Audit Requirement Target Act, which required the DHS to end its longstanding modified audit opinions, we find that following the act's implementation, the president proposed higher budgets for the DHS and the budgetary disagreement over the DHS diminished. These findings suggest that high-quality federal agency accounting influences budgetary decisions by reducing agencies' information asymmetry with politicians (the president and Congress) and taxpayers, facilitating the evaluation of agencies' spending accountability.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了美国联邦机构会计质量（以审计意见衡量）在其联邦预算分配中的作用。研究发现，当某机构收到保留审计意见时，总统提议的预算及国会通过的预算均较低，且两者间的预算分歧增大。当总统与国会有更强动机向纳税人展示支出问责性时，上述效应更为显著。利用《国土安全部审计要求目标法案》的颁布——该法案要求国土安全部终止其长期存在的保留审计意见——我们发现，在该法案实施后，总统对国土安全部提议的预算有所提高，且围绕该部的预算分歧有所减少。这些发现表明，高质量的联邦机构会计通过降低机构与政治家（总统和国会）及纳税人之间的信息不对称，促进了对机构支出问责性的评估，从而影响预算决策。
title: The role of federal agency accounting quality in federal budget allocation: Evidence from audit opinions
title_zh: 联邦机构会计质量在联邦预算分配中的作用：来自审计意见的证据

abstract: While extensive literature has explored the implications of artificial intelligence (AI) and government procurement in driving technological evolution and economic growth, the relationship between AI intensity and government procurement remains underexamined. This paper shifts focus to digital government procurement (DGP) and empirically examines its impact on corporate AI intensity using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2015 to 2022 with a two-way fixed effects model. The results demonstrate a significantly positive association between DGP and AI intensity, which holds robust across a series of robustness tests. Further analysis suggests that DGP promotes AI intensity by easing financing constraints, improving managerial capability, and enhancing human capital. The promotion effect of DGP on AI intensity is stronger for private firms, regions with higher institutional quality, and for procurement conducted by non-university government entities. This study broadens the theoretical boundary of the economic outcomes of government procurement and determinants of AI adoption, offering valuable practical implications for designing procurement strategies that effectively foster corporate AI advancement.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量文献探讨了人工智能（AI）与政府采购在推动技术演进和经济增长方面的作用，但AI强度与政府采购之间的关系仍未得到充分研究。本文将焦点转向数字政府采购（DGP），并利用2015年至2022年中国A股上市公司的样本，通过双向固定效应模型实证检验其对企业的AI强度的影响。结果显示，DGP与AI强度之间存在显著的正相关关系，这一结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。进一步分析表明，DGP通过缓解融资约束、提升管理能力和增强人力资本来促进AI强度。对于民营企业、制度质量较高的地区以及非大学政府实体进行的采购，DGP对AI强度的促进作用更为显著。本研究拓宽了政府采购经济后果及AI采纳决定因素的理论边界，为设计有效促进企业AI发展的采购策略提供了宝贵的实践启示。

abstract: Understanding how risk factors shape the economic outlook is essential for guiding policy decisions. This paper develops a flexible framework that decomposes distributional risk forecasts of macro‐economic variables into underlying contributions and supports the construction of interpretable risk measures. Multiple modeling strategies, including density and quantile regression, are accommodated underscoring the versatility of the approach. The framework is illustrated using recent U.S. inflation data, showing postpandemic risk forecasts were driven by the business cycle, commodity prices, monetary policy, and inflation expectations. Simulation studies demonstrate robustness, establishing the framework as a general tool for macro‐economic and financial risk assessment.
abstract_zh: 理解风险因素如何塑造经济前景对于指导政策决策至关重要。本文构建了一个灵活的分析框架，将宏观经济变量的分布风险预测分解为潜在贡献因素，并支持构建可解释的风险度量指标。该框架兼容密度回归与分位数回归等多种建模策略，凸显其方法论的普适性。通过近期美国通胀数据的实证分析表明，后疫情时期的风险预测主要受商业周期、大宗商品价格、货币政策及通胀预期驱动。模拟研究验证了框架的稳健性，确立了其作为宏观经济与金融风险评估通用工具的地位。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Mixing It Up: Inflation at Risk
title_zh: 混合因素：风险中的通胀

abstract: We identify a new organizational form, the Managing Agency Business Group (MABG), demonstrating how agency houses used interlocking directorships to build groups on the basis of commercial and plantation expertise to access finance on London stock markets and local capital markets in the pre‐1914 rubber boom. MABG boards combined managerial and commercial expertise with access to financial resources. Such features, rather than membership of elite groups, effectively signalled new issue quality and explained the composition of board membership in the rubber industry, which represented a substantial proportion of initial public offerings in the decade before the First World War. The MABGs used a serial finance model, through which influential intermediaries embedded in commercial networks created managerial capacity in individual estates, which were then merged with other estates, floated on the stock market, consolidated into groups, and their returns securitized through the creation of investment trusts.
abstract_zh: 我们识别出一种新型组织形式——管理代理商业集团（MABG），揭示了代理行如何通过连锁董事制度，依托商业与种植园专业知识构建集团，从而在1914年前橡胶繁荣时期获取伦敦股票市场及本地资本市场的融资。MABG董事会将管理与商业专业知识与金融资源获取能力相结合。此类特征（而非精英集团成员身份）有效传递了新发行证券的质量信号，并解释了橡胶行业董事会构成的成因——该行业在第一次世界大战前十年间占首次公开募股相当大比例。MABG采用序列融资模式，通过嵌入商业网络的有影响力的中介机构，在单个种植园中创造管理能力，随后将这些种植园与其他种植园合并、在股票市场上市、整合为集团，并通过设立投资信托将其收益证券化。
title: Managing agency business groups, elite directors, and the rubber boom, 1897–1913
title_zh: 管理代理商业集团、精英董事与橡胶繁荣，1897–1913

abstract: Does financial intermediation affect structural change? We address this question both theoretically and empirically, focusing on whether financial development reinforces structural change during the post‐industrialization phase, where employment, value‐added, and expenditure shares change towards services and away from manufacturing. We build a dynamic general equilibrium model in which structural change may be driven by mutually independent engines – sectoral productivity gaps, asymmetric factor elasticities – as well as by learning‐by‐doing. In all its variants, the model robustly predicts that exogenous reductions in intermediation costs (e.g., deregulation shocks) reinforce structural change. We take this prediction to the data by examining the effects of bank branching deregulation in the United States in the period from the 1960s to the 1990s. Within a staggered difference‐in‐differences framework, we show that bank branching deregulation reinforces the pattern of structural change already underway, leading to an increase in the services share of output and employment in deregulated states.
abstract_zh: 金融中介是否影响结构变迁？我们从理论与实证两个层面探讨这一问题，重点关注金融发展在后工业化阶段是否强化了结构变迁——即就业、增加值与支出份额从制造业向服务业转移的过程。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，其中结构变迁可能由相互独立的驱动因素——部门生产率差距、非对称要素弹性——以及干中学效应共同推动。在所有模型变体中，该模型稳健地预测：中介成本的外生降低（如放松管制冲击）会强化结构变迁。为验证这一预测，我们考察了美国20世纪60年代至90年代银行分支放松管制的效应。在交错双重差分框架下，我们证明银行分支放松管制强化了已在进行中的结构变迁模式，导致放松管制州的服务业产出与就业份额上升。
title: Financial intermediation and structural change
title_zh: 金融中介与结构性变化

abstract: We analyse the general equilibrium implications of introducing a universal basic income (UBI) for employment and income in an economy characterized by involuntary unemployment. Our framework allows tax revenues and workers' reservation wages to adjust endogenously with employment to satisfy the government's budget constraint. We show that multiple equilibria may emerge and that a UBI can support higher employment when the initial equilibrium is characterized by high taxes. However, in this setting, replacing unemployment benefit schemes with UBI proves less effective at fostering employment, ultimately requiring higher taxes and yielding more limited welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了在存在非自愿失业的经济体中引入全民基本收入（UBI）对就业和收入的一般均衡影响。我们的框架允许税收收入和工人的保留工资随就业内生调整，以满足政府预算约束。研究表明，可能出现多重均衡，且当初始均衡以高税收为特征时，UBI能够支持更高的就业水平。然而，在此设定下，用UBI替代失业救济计划在促进就业方面效果较弱，最终需要更高的税收，且带来的福利收益更为有限。
title: Basic income and employment
title_zh: 基本收入与就业

abstract: We extract information from earnings call transcripts to develop a comprehensive and reliable measure of labor shortage exposure. After validating the measure at the state, industry, and firm levels, we show that firms with labor shortage exposures experience lower earnings call CARs, future stock returns and operating performance. Firms respond to labor shortages by substituting labor with capital and R&D investments, and by producing more production-process patents. Such responses help mitigate the negative effects on future performance. Our measure has broad applicability, and our findings provide new insight into labor-capital substitution in imperfectly competitive labor markets.
abstract_zh: 我们从财报电话会议记录中提取信息，构建了一个全面且可靠的劳动力短缺暴露度指标。在州、行业和企业层面验证该指标后，我们发现，面临劳动力短缺暴露的企业，其财报电话会议期间的累计异常收益率（CARs）、未来股票回报率及经营业绩均较低。企业通过以资本和研发投资替代劳动力，并增加生产流程专利的产出，来应对劳动力短缺。这些应对措施有助于缓解对未来业绩的负面影响。我们的指标具有广泛适用性，研究结果为不完全竞争劳动力市场中的劳动-资本替代提供了新见解。
title: Firm-Level Labor Shortage Exposure
title_zh: 企业层面劳动力短缺暴露度

abstract: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) is considered essential for climate change mitigation, yet its optimal role in climate policy remains unclear in the presence of non-permanent storage, energy constraints, and fossil fuel scarcity. We integrate CDR into an analytic integrated assessment model to derive general conditions for socially optimal CDR deployment. Within a linear carbon cycle model, we consider diﬀerent CDR pathways, including direct air carbon capture, ocean alkalinity enhancement, and ocean iron fertilization. Introducing CDR does not significantly alter the optimal carbon price and the incentive to reduce emissions. The impact of CDR on gross emissions mainly stems from the energy required to operate it. This impact, as well as the optimal deployment of CDR, depends on fossil fuel scarcity and the pace of renewable energy deployment. In high-damage scenarios, the optimal deployment of CDR occurs before and around the year 2100, consistent with temperature overshoot pathways.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳移除（CDR）被视为减缓气候变化的关键手段，然而在存在非永久性封存、能源约束及化石燃料稀缺性的情况下，其在气候政策中的最优角色仍不明确。我们将CDR整合进一个分析性综合评估模型中，以推导社会最优CDR部署的一般条件。在线性碳循环模型框架内，我们考虑了不同的CDR路径，包括直接空气碳捕集、海洋碱度增强及海洋铁施肥。引入CDR并未显著改变最优碳价格及减排激励。CDR对总排放的影响主要源于其运行所需的能源。这一影响以及CDR的最优部署，取决于化石燃料的稀缺性和可再生能源部署的速度。在高损害情景下，CDR的最优部署发生在2100年前后，与温度过冲路径相一致。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: From Gross to Net: Carbon Dioxide Removal in an Analytic Climate Economy
title_zh: 从毛到净：分析性气候经济中的二氧化碳移除

abstract: This paper studies how international marriage migration affects sex ratios at birth in Vietnam. Leveraging a unique context in which the opportunity for Vietnamese women to migrate to wealthier East Asian countries increased the economic benefits of having daughters, we employ a difference-in-differences approach using a demand-driven visa processing change from Taiwan to examine whether Vietnamese households became less likely to have sons. We find a significant reduction in the likelihood of male births in affected provinces, with two fewer boys per hundred girls. We observe a decline for both first- and second-born children, with a stronger effect for the second-born when the first-born is a girl. These findings are consistent with a model incorporating both lexicographic (“at least one son”) and standard son preferences and are inconsistent with either preference alone. This highlights the nuanced role of household preferences in shaping sex selection. Overall, our results underscore the potential of policies that enhance daughters’ economic value to address gender imbalances at birth.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了国际婚姻迁移如何影响越南出生人口性别比。利用越南女性迁移至较富裕东亚国家机会增加、从而提升生育女儿经济收益的独特背景，我们采用双重差分方法，借助台湾需求驱动的签证处理变化，考察越南家庭生育儿子的可能性是否降低。研究发现，受影响省份男性出生概率显著下降，每百名女婴对应男婴减少两名。我们观察到第一胎和第二胎均出现下降，且当第一胎为女孩时，第二胎的效应更为显著。这些发现与同时包含词典式（“至少一个儿子”）和标准儿子偏好的模型一致，而与仅含任一偏好均不符。这凸显了家庭偏好在性别选择中的微妙作用。总体而言，我们的结果强调了提升女儿经济价值的政策在解决出生性别失衡方面的潜力。

abstract: We provide the first estimates of intergenerational income mobility using tax data for a large developing country, namely Brazil. We measure formal income from tax and payroll data, and we train machine learning models on census and survey data to predict informal income. We quantify the estimation bias resulting from income imputation and other sources of measurement error, and show that such bias remains negligible in our context. A 10 percentile increase in parental income rank is associated on average with a 5.5 percentile increase in child income rank, with considerable variation across sociodemographic groups and geographical areas.
abstract_zh: 我们利用巴西这一大型发展中国家的税收数据，首次估算了代际收入流动性。通过税收和工资数据衡量正规收入，并基于人口普查和调查数据训练机器学习模型以预测非正规收入。我们量化了因收入估算及其他测量误差导致的估计偏差，并证明此类偏差在我们的研究中可忽略不计。父母收入排名每提高10个百分位，子女收入排名平均上升5.5个百分位，且不同社会人口群体和地理区域之间存在显著差异。
title: Intergenerational Mobility in the Land of Inequality
title_zh: 不平等之地中的代际流动性

abstract: This paper connects changes in employer characteristics through job transitions to employee earnings following mergers and acquisitions. Using firm balance sheet data linked to individual earnings data in Canada and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that earnings of workers at target firms decrease after M&As relative to control workers, largely driven by those who move to other firms. Workers leaving targets move to larger and more profitable firms, but still experience wage declines. These decreased earnings are also concentrated among workers with longer tenure. These results are consistent with workers losing valuable match-specific premia after M&A-induced job transitions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过工作转换将雇主特征的变化与并购后员工收入联系起来。利用加拿大企业资产负债表数据与个人收入数据的关联，并采用匹配双重差分法，我们发现目标企业员工在并购后的收入相对于对照组员工有所下降，这主要源于那些跳槽至其他企业的员工。离开目标企业的员工虽转向规模更大、盈利能力更强的公司，但仍经历工资下降。这些收入下降现象还集中在任职时间较长的员工群体中。研究结果与员工在并购引发的职业转换中失去有价值的岗位特定溢价这一解释相一致。
title: Job Transitions and Employee Earnings after Acquisitions: Linking Corporate and Worker Outcomes
title_zh: 收购后的职位转换与员工收入：企业绩效与员工结果的关联

abstract: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.
abstract_zh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模的城市造林政策，该政策在不到十年内种植了33万英亩的绿地。通过对该项目的遥感审计，我们发现它显著提升了城市的绿化水平。这带来了显著的下风向空气质量改善，使城市人口聚集区的平均PM2.5浓度降低了4.2%。然而，植被的快速生长意外导致花粉暴露量增加了7.4%。对医疗索赔数据的分析显示，空气过敏原的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响与污染类似，但严重程度远低于污染。该政策的货币化净健康效益相当于该市GDP的1.5%。城市森林仅部分资本化于住房价值中，购房者主要看重靠近绿地的便利性，而非其带来的空气质量改善。

abstract: After remaining flat for decades, labor productivity at U.S. restaurants surged 15% during the COVID pandemic. The surge has persisted. We explore this using mobile phone data tracking visits and spending at 100,000 limited-service restaurants. It cannot be explained by scale economies, market power, or mechanical consequences of COVID demand fluctuations. However, restaurants’ productivity growth is strongly correlated with the share of their customers visiting for 10 minutes or less, which rose considerably during COVID and persisted. This restaurant-level relationship between labor productivity and customer dwell time is large enough to explain most of the aggregate productivity increase.
abstract_zh: 美国餐饮业的劳动生产率在数十年间保持平稳，却在新冠疫情期间骤增15%，且这一增长态势持续至今。我们利用追踪10万家有限服务餐厅客流量与消费额的手机数据展开研究。这种增长无法用规模经济、市场势力或疫情需求波动的机械效应来解释。然而，餐厅生产率增长与其顾客停留时间不超过10分钟的占比高度相关——该比例在疫情期间显著上升并持续保持。这种餐厅层面劳动生产率与顾客停留时间的关联强度，足以解释大部分总体生产率增长。
title: The Curious Surge of Productivity in U.S. Restaurants
title_zh: 美国餐饮业生产率的神秘激增

abstract: Nonprofit organizations rely on donations from large competitive marketplaces to provide key social service goods. Most research focuses on competition in output markets without considering philanthropic markets where nonprofits make decisions about how much effort to put into fundraising. We develop and estimate a model that highlights the strategic nature of fundraising, showing that rival NP’s fundraising responses can be strategic complements or substitutes. We find evidence of strategic substitutes. NPs demonstrate nontrivial strategic responses to rival’s fundraising and, in totality, the across sector impacts are important to consider. Counterfactual exercises show that reducing competition decreases equilibrium fundraising levels.
abstract_zh: 非营利组织依赖大型竞争性市场的捐赠来提供关键的社会服务产品。现有研究大多关注产出市场的竞争，而未考虑非营利组织在慈善市场中决定投入多少募捐努力的问题。我们构建并估计了一个模型，该模型凸显了募捐的战略性质，表明竞争对手非营利组织的募捐反应可能是战略互补或战略替代的。我们发现了战略替代的证据。非营利组织对竞争对手的募捐表现出不可忽视的战略反应，总体而言，跨部门的影响值得重视。反事实模拟表明，减少竞争会降低均衡募捐水平。
title: Competition and Nonprofit’s Strategic Responses: Evidence from Fundraising in Donative Markets
title_zh: 竞争与非营利组织的战略回应：来自捐赠市场筹款的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the long-term impacts of China’s nationwide public health campaigns targeting malaria, measles, and meningitis between the 1960s and 1980s. Exploiting regional variation in precampaign disease prevalence across birth cohorts, we show that these interventions generated sizable improvements in education, cognition, health, and income. As an illustrative case, individuals from high-malaria regions who were fully exposed to the eradication campaign attained about 0.5 additional years of schooling and earned over 10% higher income in adulthood, with cognitive and schooling gains explaining a substantial share of the income effects. Extending the same approach to measles and meningitis vaccination campaigns reveals comparably large benefits, with internal rates of return ranging from 21% to 34%. Together, these findings highlight the lasting socioeconomic returns to early-life health interventions and underscore the role of public health as a foundation for human capital accumulation and long-run economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60至80年代中国针对疟疾、麻疹和脑膜炎开展的全国性公共卫生运动的长期影响。利用不同出生队列在运动前疾病流行率的地区差异，我们证明这些干预措施显著改善了教育、认知、健康和收入水平。以疟疾为例，来自高疟疾地区且完全暴露于根除运动的个体，其受教育年限平均增加约0.5年，成年后收入提高超过10%，其中认知能力和教育水平的提升解释了收入效应的很大一部分。将相同方法应用于麻疹和脑膜炎疫苗接种运动后，同样发现了可观的收益，内部收益率介于21%至34%之间。这些发现共同凸显了早期健康干预的持久社会经济回报，并强调了公共卫生作为人力资本积累和长期经济增长基础的关键作用。

title: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
title_zh: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响

abstract: Since 1970, the share of Black individuals living in suburbs of large cities has risen from 16% to 36%. We first show that Black suburbanization has led to major changes in neighborhoods, accounting for the majority of recent increases in both the average Black individual’s neighborhood quality and income segregation within the Black population. We then use an accounting exercise to show that changes in relative suburban amenities and housing prices explain a large share of Black suburbanization, while regional reallocation, changing educational attainment, and gentrification of Black city neighborhoods play only minor roles.
abstract_zh: 自1970年以来，居住在大城市郊区的黑人比例已从16%上升至36%。我们首先表明，黑人郊区化导致了社区的重大变化，这解释了近年来黑人个体平均社区质量提升以及黑人群体内部收入隔离加剧的大部分原因。随后，我们通过核算分析表明，郊区相对便利设施和房价的变化解释了黑人郊区化的很大一部分原因，而区域重新分配、教育程度变化以及黑人城市社区的绅士化仅起到次要作用。
title: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
title_zh: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果

abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how dietary habits – a key health behavior – are transmitted across generations, exploiting unique grocery transaction data linked with administrative records. We document strong intergenerational persistence in dietary habits, exceeding that of income, and consider several channels that might explain this pattern. Specifically, we find that socioeconomic status and geography account for only a small share of the transmission. Combined with the absence of a dietary response following a parent’s unexpected lifestyle-related death, these findings underscore the importance of early-life influences and habit formation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与行政记录相关联的独特杂货交易数据，提供了关于饮食习惯——这一关键健康行为——如何代际传递的新证据。我们记录了饮食习惯中显著的代际持续性，其程度超过收入，并考察了可能解释这一模式的若干渠道。具体而言，我们发现社会经济地位和地理因素仅能解释传递中的一小部分。结合父母因生活方式相关意外死亡后饮食行为未发生变化的发现，这些结果强调了早期生活影响和习惯形成的重要性。
title: The Apple Does Not Fall Far From the Tree: Intergenerational Persistence of Dietary Habits
title_zh: 苹果不会落在离树太远的地方：饮食习惯的代际持续性

abstract: Market power is costly to build and, once established, is typically persistent and difficult to change. This paper investigates the impact of large economic shocks (serious epidemics) on the redistribution of market power in manufacturing industries. Using a model of firms’ dynamic decisions on production, pricing, and inventory holding, we demonstrate the importance of inventory stock and demand uncertainty in understanding market power and propose a new measure of market power. We find that the 2003 SARS shock in China significantly reduced the market power of firms in SARS-impacted areas. This effect is long lasting. SARS also substantially increased the inventory of affected firms, which partially contributed to the redistribution of market power.
abstract_zh: 市场势力的构建成本高昂，且一旦形成便具有显著的持久性和难以改变的特征。本文探究了重大经济冲击（严重流行病）对制造业市场势力再分配的影响。通过构建企业生产、定价与库存持有动态决策模型，我们论证了库存规模与需求不确定性在理解市场势力中的关键作用，并提出了一种新的市场势力测度方法。研究发现，2003年中国非典疫情冲击显著降低了疫区企业的市场势力，且该效应具有长期持续性。非典疫情还大幅增加了受影响企业的库存水平，这在一定程度上推动了市场势力的再分配。

title: How Do Large Epidemics Redistribute Market Power? Evidence from the 2003 SARS Shock in China
title_zh: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据

abstract: Against a backdrop of sharply rising inequality, the Tokyo Round of the GATT resulted in a 1.6 percentage point reduction in average US tariffs – larger than CUSFTA, NAFTA, and the liberalization accompanying the granting of PNTR to China. We construct a novel IV based on the so-called “Swiss formula” that governed the Tokyo Round tariff liberalization to provide evidence of its effects on imports and inequality. Instrumented tariff reductions explain approximately 20% of the rise in income inequality between non-production and production workers between 1979 and 1988. This effect is largest among women, workers in routine occupations, and workers in more technology-intensive industries, suggesting a complementarity between trade liberalization and skill-biased technological change.
abstract_zh: 在收入不平等急剧加剧的背景下，关贸总协定东京回合使美国平均关税降低了1.6个百分点——这一降幅大于美加自由贸易协定、北美自由贸易协定以及给予中国永久正常贸易关系地位时的贸易自由化幅度。我们基于指导东京回合关税自由化的所谓"瑞士公式"构建了一个新的工具变量，以证明其对进口和不平等的影响。工具变量估计的关税削减解释了1979年至1988年间非生产工人与生产工人之间收入不平等上升的约20%。这一效应在女性、从事常规职业的工人以及技术密集型行业的工人中最为显著，表明贸易自由化与技能偏向型技术进步之间存在互补性。

title: Trade and U.S. Inequality in the Tokyo Round
title_zh: 东京回合中的贸易与美国不平等

abstract: We examine firm responses to state hiring and investment subsidies. We leverage institutional features of the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), a large-scale business incentive program that incorporates best practices from prior job creation policies. The CCTC award selection procedure combines formula-based and discretionary components. Leveraging applicant score eligibility cutoffs in a regression discontinuity design and taking advantage of rich longitudinal microdata on establishments and their parent firms, we find that businesses expand employment in California in response to CCTC awards. There is little evidence that these expansions come at the expense of firms’ operations in other states. Our results suggest that targeted and audited hiring and investment subsidies can be effective in promoting local business expansions without inducing significant cross-state displacement effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业对州级雇佣与投资补贴的响应。我们利用加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）的制度特征——这一大规模商业激励计划整合了以往就业创造政策的最佳实践。CCTC奖项评选程序结合了公式化与自由裁量两种机制。通过运用断点回归设计，基于申请者评分资格临界值，并借助涵盖企业及其母公司的丰富纵向微观数据，我们发现企业因获得CCTC奖项而在加州扩大了就业规模。几乎没有证据表明这种扩张是以牺牲企业在其他州的运营为代价。我们的研究结果表明，经过精准定位与审计的雇佣及投资补贴，能够有效促进本地企业扩张，且不会引发显著的跨州替代效应。
title: Firm Responses to Hiring and Investment Subsidies: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from the California Competes Tax Credit
title_zh: 企业应对招聘与投资补贴的反应：来自加州竞争税收抵免的断点回归证据

abstract: We study the role of war bonds and inflation in post-WWII federal elections. After WWII, major bouts of inflation in 1946-48 and 1950-51 depressed the real returns of the bonds sold to households during the war. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with higher war bond purchases shifted their votes towards the Republican Party in postwar elections. To address the endogeneity of war bond purchases, we use an instrumental variables design, and obtain similar results. Bond ownership raised the saliency of inflation, and the severe rise in prices after the war triggered a backlash against the incumbent Democrats.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了二战后的战争债券与通货膨胀在联邦选举中的作用。二战后，1946-48年和1950-51年的两次重大通胀压低了战争期间向家庭出售债券的实际回报。在双重差分框架下，我们发现战争债券购买量更高的县在战后选举中投票转向共和党。为解决战争债券购买的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量设计，并得到类似结果。债券持有提高了通胀的显著性，战后物价的急剧上涨引发了选民对在任民主党人的强烈反对。
title: Inflation, War Bonds, and Voter Backlash in the 1950s
title_zh: 20世纪50年代的通胀、战争债券与选民反弹

abstract: We document that in response to intensified competition from China in the U.S., poor countries reduce their export prices relative to rich countries, consistent with conventional wisdom. Interestingly, however, the opposite is true for export quantities. To reconcile these facts, we develop and estimate a general equilibrium model of trade featuring (i) cross-country heterogeneity in the ability to produce high-quality goods and (ii) a two-dimensional Bertrand competition on price and quality. Our model explains the empirical facts by showing that rich countries have a comparative advantage in quality upgrading, whereas a nested model without quality cannot do so.
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，面对中国在美国市场竞争加剧的情况，贫困国家相对于富裕国家降低了出口价格，这与传统观点一致。然而有趣的是，出口数量却呈现相反趋势。为调和这些事实，我们构建并估计了一个包含以下特征的贸易一般均衡模型：（i）各国生产高质量产品能力的异质性，以及（ii）价格与质量二维伯特兰竞争。该模型通过揭示富裕国家在质量升级方面具有比较优势来解释实证现象，而嵌套的无质量模型则无法做到这一点。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Cross-Country Heterogeneous Response to Competition: Theory and Evidence from Trade Data
title_zh: 跨国竞争反应的异质性：理论与贸易数据的证据

abstract: We study how regional housing market disruptions spill over across US local markets through multimarket firm networks. Using granular barcode-level data linked to producer information, we exploit variation in firms’ exposure to local house price declines. A firm’s local sales respond more strongly to indirect housing price declines in its other markets than to direct local declines. The barcode-level data reveal a novel uniform product replacement mechanism: Firms respond to adverse shocks by replacing higher-value products with lower-value alternatives uniformly across all markets. This propagates regional demand shocks through the supply side, with new implications for regional economics.
abstract_zh: 本文研究区域住房市场冲击如何通过跨市场企业网络在美国地方市场间传导。利用与生产者信息相关联的细粒度条形码级数据，我们考察了企业对当地房价下跌的暴露程度差异。研究发现，企业在其其他市场面临的间接房价下跌对其本地销售的影响，比直接本地房价下跌更为显著。条形码级数据揭示了一种新颖的统一产品替代机制：企业通过在所有市场中统一用低价值产品替代高价值产品来应对不利冲击。这一机制通过供给侧将区域需求冲击进行传导，为区域经济学提供了新的启示。
title: Spillovers through Multimarket Firms: The Uniform Product Replacement Channel
title_zh: 多市场企业的溢出效应：统一产品替代渠道

abstract: How do import tariffs affect employment? We develop an empirical strategy to identify the effects of tariffs using a difference-in-differences strategy, comparing antidumping (AD) investigations resulting in AD tariffs to those not resulting in AD tariffs. We find that an AD tariff decreases imports and increases employment in the protected sector. Moreover, employment in downstream firms decreases, while upstream firms are unaffected because the protected sector sources inputs abroad. Using a model to quantify the aggregate effects, we find that the Brazilian AD policy increased employment by 0.06% at a welfare loss of 2.4%.
abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响就业？我们采用双重差分策略来识别关税效应，通过比较导致反倾销税的反倾销调查与未导致反倾销税的反倾销调查。研究发现，反倾销税会减少进口并增加受保护部门的就业。此外，下游企业的就业减少，而上游企业未受影响，因为受保护部门从国外采购投入品。通过模型量化总体效应，我们发现巴西的反倾销政策使就业增加0.06%，但福利损失达2.4%。
title: The Employment Consequences of Anti-Dumping Tariffs: Lessons from Brazil
title_zh: 反倾销关税的就业后果：来自巴西的教训

abstract: This study explores the relationship between legalized sports gambling, unexpected emotional cues stemming from NFL home team upset losses and reported intimate partner violence (IPV). Using 1995–2022 crime data from NIBRS, replicating and extending Card and Dahl (2011)’s model, we find that legalized gambling increases the impact of upset losses on IPV by 10 percentage points. The e!ect is larger in states with mobile betting, where higher bets were placed, around paydays, and for teams on a winning streak. These results suggest that financial losses from gambling amplify emotional reactions to unexpected team losses.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了合法化体育博彩、NFL主队爆冷失利引发的意外情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）报告之间的关系。利用1995-2022年NIBRS犯罪数据，复制并扩展了Card和Dahl（2011）的模型，我们发现合法化博彩使爆冷失利对IPV的影响增加了10个百分点。在允许移动投注的州、投注金额较高的地区、发薪日前后以及处于连胜状态的球队中，这一效应更为显著。这些结果表明，博彩带来的经济损失放大了对球队意外失利的情绪反应。
title: Sports Betting Legalization Amplifies Emotional Cues and Intimate Partner Violence
title_zh: 体育博彩合法化加剧情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力

abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers dominate the U.S. pharmaceutical market but are controversial and poorly understood. We analyze PBMs as market intermediaries that operate formulary contests in which on-patent brand-drug makers compete for favorable placement by offering rebates off list price. These formulary contests deliver efficiency gains compared to drug makers selling directly to consumers; PBMs capture some of these gains. Our approach answers key questions regarding the determinants of efficiency, rebates, list prices, and PBM market power in the pharmaceutical market. Our analysis also explains how common contracting practices, federal regulations, and incentives within formulary contests can undermine market efficiency.
abstract_zh: 药品福利管理公司主导着美国药品市场，但颇具争议且认知度较低。我们将PBM视为市场中介机构，其运作处方集竞争机制——专利品牌药制造商通过提供标价折扣来争夺有利的处方集地位。相较于药企直接面向消费者销售的模式，这种处方集竞争机制能带来效率提升；PBM则从中获取部分收益。我们的分析框架解答了关于药品市场效率决定因素、折扣机制、标价形成及PBM市场势力的关键问题。研究同时揭示了处方集竞争中的常见合同实践、联邦监管规定及激励机制如何可能削弱市场效率。
title: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
title_zh: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者

abstract: Counterfactuals in quantitative trade and spatial models are functions of the current state of the world and the model parameters. Common practice treats the current state of the world as perfectly observed, but there is good reason to believe that it is measured with error. This paper provides tools for quantifying uncertainty about counterfactuals when the current state of the world is measured with error. I recommend an empirical Bayes approach to uncertainty quantification, and show that it is both practical and theoretically justified.
abstract_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的反事实分析依赖于当前世界状态与模型参数。现有研究通常将当前世界状态视为完全可观测的，但实际测量中很可能存在误差。本文提供了当当前世界状态存在测量误差时，量化反事实分析不确定性的工具。我推荐采用经验贝叶斯方法进行不确定性量化，并证明该方法兼具实用性与理论合理性。
title: Measurement Error and Counterfactuals in Quantitative Trade and Spatial Models
title_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的测量误差与反事实分析

abstract: We investigate the role financial conditions play in the composition of U.S. growth-at-risk. We document that, by a wide margin, growth-at-risk is investment-at-risk. That is, if financial conditions indicate U.S. real GDP growth will be in the lower tail of its conditional distribution, we know that quantitatively, the main contributor is a decline in investment. Consumption contributes under extreme financial stress. Government spending and net exports do not play a role. We show that leverage plays a key role in determining both consumption- and investment-at-risk, which provides support to the financial accelerator mechanism proposed by Bernanke et al. (1999).
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融状况在美国增长风险构成中的作用。实证表明，增长风险在很大程度上即为投资风险。也就是说，若金融状况预示美国实际GDP增长将处于条件分布的下尾端，从量化角度看，其主要贡献因素来自投资下降。消费仅在极端金融压力下有所贡献，而政府支出与净出口则未发挥显著作用。我们进一步发现，杠杆水平在决定消费风险与投资风险中均扮演关键角色，这为Bernanke等（1999）提出的金融加速器机制提供了实证支持。
title: Growth-at-Risk Is Investment-at-Risk
title_zh: 增长风险即投资风险

abstract: This paper uncovers that input tariff reductions result in less domestic innovation, but standard models of trade ensure a positive correlation between importing and innovation. Hence, the paper develops a dynamic framework with a task-specific laboraugmenting productivity and a non-homothetic import demand system to rationalize this finding. The model implies that input liberalization enables firms to use cheaper intermediate imports as a substitute for self-made inputs, a strategy that decreases marginal production costs but also discourages firms from investing in their own inhouse varieties. Finally, the paper compares the effectiveness of trade and innovation policies in boosting aggregate productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 本文发现，投入品关税削减导致国内创新减少，而标准贸易模型却认为进口与创新之间存在正相关关系。为此，本文构建了一个包含任务特定劳动增强型生产率与非同质进口需求体系的动态框架，以解释这一发现。模型表明，投入品自由化使企业能够用更便宜的进口中间品替代自制投入品，这一策略虽降低了边际生产成本，但也抑制了企业对自主开发内部品种的投资。最后，本文比较了贸易政策与创新政策在促进全要素生产率增长方面的有效性。
title: Globalization, Innovation, and Margins of Sourcing
title_zh: 全球化、创新与采购边际

abstract: We use administrative data to measure sibling spillovers on academic performance before and after the introduction of Free Secondary Education (FSE) in Tanzania. Prior to FSE, students whose older siblings narrowly passed the secondary school entrance exam were less likely to go to secondary school themselves; with FSE, the effect became positive. A triple-differences analysis, using geographic variation in FSE exposure, shows that FSE caused the reversal. Mechanism analyses suggest that changes in parental investments were a more likely channel for this reversal than direct sibling interactions. By alleviating financial constraints, FSE allowed households to invest in more children.
abstract_zh: 我们利用行政数据，衡量坦桑尼亚实施免费中等教育（FSE）前后，兄弟姐妹对学业表现的溢出效应。在FSE实施前，其兄姐以微弱优势通过中学入学考试的学生，自身升入中学的可能性反而更低；而FSE实施后，这一效应转为正向。通过利用FSE覆盖范围的地理差异进行三重差分分析，结果表明FSE导致了这一逆转。机制分析表明，相较于直接的兄弟姐妹互动，父母投资的变化更可能是这一逆转的传导渠道。通过缓解经济约束，FSE使家庭能够对更多子女进行教育投资。
title: Sibling Spillovers and Free Schooling
title_zh: 兄弟姐妹溢出效应与免费教育

abstract: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)—the second tier of its public DI system—for cohorts born after 1960. Using administrative data, we first document that, in the long run, overall DI inflows declined by roughly one-third. Second, using representative survey data, we document at best modest ODI insurance take-up responses in the private individual, risk-rated market, which lacks guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model incorporating interactions between the public safety net, the first-tier public DI, and the private market reveals that coverage denials and weak insurance demand, driven by complementary social insurance, can explain the modest private ODI take-up response. Coverage gradients by income and health are thus substantial. Finally, counterfactual simulations highlight the limited scope of incremental reforms.
abstract_zh: 2001年，德国废除了针对1960年后出生群体的公共职业伤残保险（ODI）——其公共伤残保险体系的第二层级。基于行政数据，我们首先发现，从长期来看，总体伤残保险流入量下降了约三分之一。其次，利用代表性调查数据，我们发现在缺乏保证承保条款的风险评级私人市场中，ODI保险的参保反应充其量仅为温和水平。第三，通过构建包含公共安全网、第一层级公共伤残保险与私人市场之间相互作用的均衡模型，我们发现：由补充性社会保险驱动的承保拒绝与疲弱的保险需求，可以解释私人ODI参保反应的温和特征。由此，按收入与健康水平划分的保障梯度差异显著。最后，反事实模拟凸显了渐进式改革的有限空间。
title: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 从根本上改革伤残保险体系：来自德国的证据

abstract: This paper investigates fairness perceptions of extreme income inequality generated in winner-take-all competitions. Two large-scale experiments with more than 7,000 participants from the general population of the U.S. show that extreme earnings inequality is widely accepted, even when the winner only slightly outperforms the runner-up. The effect of the winning margin on inequality acceptance is modest compared to the effect of shifting the source of inequality from luck to winning by the smallest possible margin. The experimental choices are systematically associated with broader fairness attitudes and policy preferences, including support for higher taxation of top earners and redistributive economic policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在赢家通吃竞争中所产生的极端收入不平等现象的公平感知问题。两项涵盖美国普通民众超过7000名参与者的大规模实验表明，极端收入不平等被广泛接受，即便获胜者仅以微弱优势领先亚军。与将不平等来源从运气转向最小可能获胜差距的影响相比，获胜差距对不平等接受程度的影响相对较小。实验选择与更广泛的公平态度及政策偏好存在系统性关联，包括支持对高收入者征收更高税率及再分配经济政策。
title: Fairness in Winner-Take-All Competitions
title_zh: 赢者通吃竞争中的公平性

abstract: This paper introduces a key factor influencing households’ decision to invest in the stock market: how people view stockholders. Using surveys we conducted with nearly 8,500 individuals from 11 countries, we document that a large majority hold negative views of stockholders based on identity-relevant characteristics. Linking survey and administrative data, we find that negative perceptions strongly predict households’ stock market participation. We show that negative perceptions causally influence household decision-making and provide evidence supporting identity concerns as the underlying mechanism. Our findings provide new perspectives on the malleability of financial decision-making and a novel explanation for low stock market participation.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个影响家庭股市投资决策的关键因素：人们对股票持有者的看法。基于对11个国家近8500名受访者的调查，我们发现绝大多数人对股票持有者持有负面看法，这些看法与身份特征相关。通过将调查数据与行政数据关联分析，我们证实负面看法能显著预测家庭的股市参与行为。研究表明，负面看法对家庭决策具有因果影响，并提供了身份认同关切作为潜在机制的证据。这一发现为金融决策的可塑性提供了新视角，也为股市参与率偏低现象提供了全新解释。
title: Proud to Not Own Stocks: How Identity Shapes Financial Decisions
title_zh: 以不持有股票为荣：身份认同如何塑造金融决策

abstract: This study investigates how increased female representation in executive positions within local governments affects municipal expenditures. We leverage a 2014 reform in Italy that mandated 40% gender quotas in the executive councils of municipalities with more than 3000 residents. To isolate the impact of gender quotas from other policies active at the same population cutoff, we employ a difference-in-discontinuities approach. We document that the policy effectively increases female representation in local governments, bringing younger, less politically experienced female politicians into executive councils. We find that increased female representation shifts resources away from culture and toward education, with spending shares rising by 25% for preschool and decreasing by 47% for culture. This indicates that including more women in executive roles can influence the allocation of municipal resources, even if it does not alter total spending levels.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨地方政府行政职位中女性代表比例提升对市政支出的影响。我们利用意大利2014年实施的一项改革，该改革规定居民超过3000人的市镇行政委员会中女性配额须达到40%。为将性别配额的影响与同一人口阈值下其他政策的作用区分开来，我们采用断点回归差分法。研究证实，该政策有效提升了地方政府中的女性代表比例，使更年轻、政治经验较少的女性政治家进入行政委员会。我们发现，女性代表比例的提高促使资源从文化领域转向教育领域，学前教育支出份额上升25%，而文化支出份额下降47%。这表明，即使不改变总支出水平，增加女性在行政职务中的参与也能影响市政资源的分配格局。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Gender quotas in municipal executives: reallocating public spending in Italy
title_zh: 市政行政中的性别配额：意大利公共支出的重新分配

abstract: Most comparative analyses explaining the 1970s and 1990s/2000s inflation performance, focusing on good/bad policy versus good/bad luck, assume that price and wage-setting institutions remained constant. While studies acknowledge institutional changes, they typically overlook sources of intrinsic persistence of wage and price inflation. This paper contributes to this ongoing debate by revisiting the U.S. business cycle. We account for time variations in pricing and wage-setting behavior due to institutional changes and for switches in inflation-intrinsic persistence, which we formally represent as changes in the shape of the hazard function. By analyzing how policy and shocks interact within different institutional settings in our model economy, we trace the existing contrasting evidence back to an identification problem that biases regime estimates and leads to misleading interpretations. Once we account for persistence switches, the empirical outcomes strongly support, but refine, the luck interpretation over the policy interpretation. The 1970s were characterized not only by larger shocks but also by more pronounced transmission mechanisms of supply shocks, driven by the price- and wage-setting institutions of the time. Additionally, the data suggest to reinterpret the monetary regimes more in line with the central bankers’ view and show that structural changes in price and wage adjustments play essential and opposite roles in the Great Inflation. Finally, our analysis yields two important general findings. First, it emphasizes the critical role that changes in price and wage-setting institutions play in influencing the propagation of shocks. Second, it validates the use of a generalized time-dependent rule to represent nominal rigidities.
abstract_zh: 大多数比较分析在解释1970年代与1990年代/2000年代的通胀表现时，聚焦于政策优劣与运气好坏之争，均假设价格与工资设定制度保持不变。尽管部分研究承认制度变迁的存在，但通常忽略了工资与价格通胀内在持续性的根源。本文通过重新审视美国商业周期，为这一持续争论做出贡献。我们考虑了因制度变迁导致的定价与工资设定行为的时间变化，以及通胀内在持续性的转变——这种转变在形式上表现为风险函数形态的变化。通过分析政策与冲击在我们模型经济中不同制度环境下的交互作用，我们将现有相互矛盾的证据追溯至一个识别问题：该问题导致对制度区间的估计产生偏差，并引发误导性解读。一旦我们纳入持续性转变因素，实证结果便强烈支持（但修正了）运气解释优于政策解释的结论。1970年代不仅面临更大的冲击，更因当时的价格与工资设定制度，导致供给冲击的传导机制更为显著。此外，数据表明应重新解读货币制度，使其更符合央行官员的视角，并揭示价格与工资调整的结构性变化在大通胀中扮演了关键且对立的作用。最后，我们的分析得出两项重要的一般性结论：第一，强调价格与工资设定制度变迁在影响冲击传导中的关键作用；第二，验证了使用广义时间依赖规则来表征名义刚性的有效性。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The U.S. Economic Dynamics and Inflation Persistence: A Regime-Switching Perspective
title_zh: 美国经济动态与通胀持续性：基于体制转换视角

abstract: We study the feasibility of opening new mines in ethnically diverse countries without escalating the risk of conflict. We propose a theoretical model in which ethnic groups can organize themselves to fight at the national or the local level. Our model yields two key insights. First, peace cannot be guaranteed in the presence of ethnic segregation and spatial resource inequality. Second, once the peace-maximizing policies are implemented, local conflict risks depend on local resource rents and local ethnic groups as well as the country’s entire ethnic and mining geography. We validate key concepts from our model using granular spatial data from Sierra Leone and the rest of sub-Saharan Africa and employing a shift-share identification strategy. We then apply these concepts to simulate the potential impact of planned mining projects in Sierra Leone and confirm that projects in the right locations can promote peace. We offer policy recommendations for making the mining industry a facilitator of peace and prosperity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在多民族国家中开设新矿而不加剧冲突风险的可行性。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中各民族群体可在国家或地方层面组织起来进行斗争。该模型得出两个关键结论：第一，在存在民族隔离与空间资源不平等的情况下，无法保障和平；第二，一旦实施最大化和平的政策，地方冲突风险不仅取决于地方资源租金和地方民族群体，还取决于整个国家的民族与矿业地理格局。我们利用塞拉利昂及撒哈拉以南非洲其他地区的精细空间数据，并采用份额转移识别策略，验证了模型中的核心概念。随后，我们运用这些概念模拟了塞拉利昂计划中采矿项目的潜在影响，证实选址得当的项目能够促进和平。最后，我们提出政策建议，旨在使采矿业成为和平与繁荣的推动者。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Mining for Peace,
title_zh: 为和平而采矿

abstract: We study the effect of risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 331,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays significantly reduce importers’ sales, profits, and employment. We then show that firms actively diversify weather risk by using more routes and foreign suppliers, although their import values decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with supply chain risk.
abstract_zh: 本文研究风险如何影响企业供应链组织方式。我们利用美国制造业进口的交易层面数据，基于海运时间的历史波动性构建了投入品采购风险的新测度指标。该指标通过分析超过33.1万条海运航线的天气条件，分离出运输时间中由天气因素引发的意外波动。首先，我们证实运输时间的意外延迟会显著降低进口商的销售额、利润和就业水平。其次，我们发现企业会通过增加航线数量和海外供应商来主动分散天气风险，尽管其进口总额有所下降。为解释这些发现，我们将运输时间风险引入具有企业异质性的进口一般均衡模型。定量分析预测，供应链风险将给美国经济带来巨大成本。
title: Input Sourcing under Climate Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
title_zh: 气候风险下的投入品采购：来自美国制造业企业的证据

abstract: Multiple hypothesis testing (MHT) practices vary widely, without consensus on which are appropriate when. This article provides an economic foundation for these practices designed to capture leading examples, such as regulatory approval on the basis of clinical trials. MHT adjustments are appropriate in our framework to the extent that research costs are invariant to the number of hypotheses. Control of average size, as for example via a Bonferroni correction, emerges in the limit case where all costs are fixed; in the opposite limit, where costs vary in proportion to the hypothesis count, no correction is needed. We illustrate implications by calculating explicit critical values using data on actual costs in the drug approval process and in program evaluation research; these suggest that some MHT adjustment is warranted in these applications, but not as much as implied by standard practice.
abstract_zh: 多重假设检验（MHT）的实践方法差异显著，且对于何种情境下应采用何种方法尚未形成共识。本文为这些实践方法提供了经济学基础，旨在涵盖典型案例（如基于临床试验的监管审批）。在我们的框架中，当研究成本不随假设数量变化时，MHT调整是适当的。在成本完全固定的极限情形下，平均检验规模的控制（例如通过邦费罗尼校正）得以实现；而在另一极端情形下，当成本与假设数量成比例变化时，则无需进行校正。我们通过利用药品审批流程及项目评估研究中实际成本数据计算显式临界值，阐释了相关含义：这些结果表明，在上述应用中需进行一定程度的MHT调整，但调整幅度不应如标准实践所暗示的那样大。
title: A Model of Multiple Hypothesis Testing
title_zh: 多重假设检验的一个模型

abstract: Linear instrumental variable estimators, such as two-stage least squares (TSLS), are commonly interpreted as estimating non-negatively weighted averages of causal effects, referred to as local average treatment effects (LATEs). We examine whether the LATE interpretation actually applies to the types of TSLS specifications that are used in practice. We show that if the specification includes covariates—which most empirical work does—then the LATE interpretation does not apply in general. Instead, the TSLS estimator will, in general, reflect treatment effects for both compliers and always/never-takers, and some treatment effects for the always/never-takers will necessarily be negatively weighted. We show that the only specifications that have a LATE interpretation are “saturated” specifications that control for covariates nonparametrically, implying that such specifications are both sufficient and necessary for TSLS to have a LATE interpretation, at least without additional parametric assumptions. This result is concerning because, as we document, empirical researchers almost never control for covariates nonparametrically, and rarely discuss or justify parametric specifications of covariates. We apply our results to thirteen empirical studies and find strong evidence that the LATE interpretation of TSLS is far from accurate for the types of specifications actually used in practice. We offer concrete recommendations for practice motivated by our theoretical and empirical results.
abstract_zh: 线性工具变量估计量（如两阶段最小二乘法，TSLS）通常被解释为对因果效应的非负加权平均，即局部平均处理效应（LATE）。本文考察了LATE解释是否实际适用于实践中使用的TSLS设定形式。研究表明，若设定中包含协变量（多数实证研究均如此），则LATE解释通常不再适用。此时，TSLS估计量将同时反映依从者与始终/从不接受治疗者的处理效应，且始终/从不接受治疗者的部分处理效应必然被赋予负权重。我们证明，唯一具有LATE解释的设定是“饱和”设定——即通过非参数方式控制协变量，这意味着此类设定既是TSLS获得LATE解释的充分条件也是必要条件（至少在没有额外参数假设的情况下）。这一结论令人担忧，因为据我们记录，实证研究者几乎从未采用非参数方式控制协变量，且极少讨论或论证协变量的参数设定形式。我们将研究结果应用于13项实证研究，发现对于实践中实际使用的设定类型，TSLS的LATE解释远非准确。基于理论与实证结果，我们为实践操作提供了具体建议。
title:
When is TSLS
                    Actually
                    LATE?
title_zh: TSLS何时实际上是LATE？

abstract: This article reconsiders the question of optimal labour income taxes for the very rich in the context of a flexible moral hazard model. In this setting, risk is not exogenous. Rather, each agent can affect the probabilities of all possible income outcomes by allocating a fixed time endowment across a variety of distinct tasks. I prove that the optimal income tax rates on high-end earners and the optimal Pareto tail index of the pre-tax labour income distribution are both endogenously determined by agent preferences. In particular, a society with less risk-averse agents will find it optimal to impose a lower tax rate on the rich, even though its members’ choices give rise to a smaller Pareto right tail index. In contrast, this kind of negative co-movement between inequality and optimal tax rates is a suboptimal response in the classical Mirrlees (1971)–Diamond (1998)–Saez (2001) setup to changes in the exogenous distribution of skills.
abstract_zh: 本文在灵活的道德风险模型框架下重新审视了针对极高收入者的最优劳动所得税问题。在此设定中，风险并非外生变量。相反，每个行为人可通过将固定时间禀赋分配至多种不同任务，影响所有可能收入结果的发生概率。本文证明，高收入者的最优所得税率与税前劳动收入分布的最优帕累托尾部指数均由行为人偏好内生决定。具体而言，在行为人风险厌恶程度较低的社会中，即使其成员的选择导致更小的帕累托右尾指数，最优政策仍倾向于对富人征收更低的税率。与之形成对比的是，在经典的Mirrlees（1971）–Diamond（1998）–Saez（2001）框架下，这种不平等程度与最优税率之间的负向联动关系，实为对外生技能分布变化的次优反应。
title: Optimal Labour Income Taxation: A Flexible Moral Hazard Approach
title_zh: 最优劳动收入税：一种灵活的道德风险方法

abstract: We analyse discontinuous Markovian strategies for differential games. The best response correspondence uniquely maps almost all profiles of opponents’ strategies back to the strategy space. We thus make Markov-perfect equilibria in a wide class of differential games well-behaved, resolving a long-standing open problem. We provide a readily applicable necessary and sufficient condition for best responses and Markov-perfect Nash equilibria. We demonstrate our methods in a canonical model of non-cooperative mitigation of climate change. Our approach provides novel, economically important results: we obtain the entire set of symmetric Markov-perfect equilibria and demonstrate that the best equilibria can yield a major welfare improvement over the equilibrium which previous literature has focused on. International climate negotiations can be seen as being about coordination on good equilibria, rather than about bargaining over the limited surplus available in a dynamic prisoner’s dilemma.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了微分博弈中的不连续马尔可夫策略。最优反应对应将几乎所有对手策略的剖面唯一映射回策略空间。由此，我们使广泛一类微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡具有良好的性质，解决了一个长期存在的开放性问题。我们给出了一个易于应用的最优反应与马尔可夫完美纳什均衡的充要条件。我们通过一个非合作减缓气候变化的经典模型展示了该方法。我们的方法提供了新颖且具有重要经济意义的结果：我们得到了全部对称马尔可夫完美均衡集，并证明最优均衡相较于以往文献所关注的均衡能够带来显著的福利改善。国际气候谈判可被视为关于良好均衡的协调，而非在动态囚徒困境的有限剩余上进行讨价还价。
title: Markov-Perfect Equilibria in Differential Games—With an Application to Climate Policy
title_zh: 微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡——兼论其在气候政策中的应用

abstract: More than half a century ago, experimental economists came up with a set of rigorous methodological principles that revolutionized the way economists think—and that have defined the field ever since. Pivotal among them are the no-deception norm, the use of abstract instructions, induced-value theory, and the use of incentives in experiments. In this paper I revisit these principles, critically examining their origins and justifications, and explore their stand in current research, given the new challenges posed by online experiments, cross-disciplinary spillovers, and the evolving landscape of behavioral research. I conclude that we have become too rigidly attached to our methodologies and should adopt a more flexible, context-sensitive, and less-dogmatic approach.
abstract_zh: 半个多世纪前，实验经济学家提出了一套严谨的方法论原则，彻底改变了经济学家的思维方式，并自此定义了该领域。其中关键原则包括不欺骗规范、使用抽象指令、诱导价值理论以及在实验中使用激励措施。本文重新审视这些原则，批判性地探讨其起源与合理性，并考察它们在当前研究中的地位，鉴于在线实验、跨学科溢出效应以及行为研究不断演变的格局所带来的新挑战。我得出结论，我们已过于僵化地固守方法论，应当采取更为灵活、情境敏感且较少教条化的方法。

title: Experimental methods: Revisiting the commandments of experimental economics

abstract: This paper studies how flattening government hierarchy shapes firm creation and aggregate productivity. Exploiting the staggered implementation of China’s government reorganization with comprehensive firm registration data, we find that this delayering of government substantially hindered firm creation and reduced aggregate productivity, with effects especially pronounced among larger enterprises. We discuss two primary channels driving this result: weakened coordination arising from expanded provincial control and intensified vertical political competition between prefecture and county governments. Our findings highlight that flattening government hierarchy can generate unintended economic frictions, potentially offsetting its intended benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府层级扁平化如何影响企业创立与总体生产率。利用中国政府机构改革的错峰实施及全面的企业注册数据，我们发现这一政府层级精简显著阻碍了企业创立并降低了总体生产率，其中对大型企业的影响尤为突出。我们讨论了两条主要作用机制：省级控制范围扩大导致的协调弱化，以及地级市与县级政府间垂直政治竞争的加剧。我们的研究结果表明，政府层级扁平化可能引发非预期的经济摩擦，从而可能抵消其预期收益。

abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on income tax evasion by the self-employed, using a novel dataset that links a household consumption survey with tax administration records in Italy. We find that the share of unreported income among self-employed households is approximately one-third of total income, a magnitude comparable to that documented in countries with substantially lower aggregate evasion. We show that income tax evasion primarily originates among liberal professionals, who underreport their income by about twice as much as small businesses do. The results suggest that Italy’s high aggregate evasion rate is driven primarily by the composition of economic activity and evasion opportunities, rather than by uniformly higher individual propensities to evade or weaker tax morale. Our distributional analysis reveals that tax evasion substantially distorts vertical and horizontal equity, worsening both forms of equity and increasing inequality in the tax burden across households.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一项将意大利家庭消费调查与税务管理记录相结合的新数据集，为自雇人士的所得税逃税行为提供了新颖证据。我们发现，自雇家庭未申报收入约占总收入的三分之一，这一规模与总体逃税率显著较低的国家所记录的情况相当。研究显示，所得税逃税主要源于自由职业者，其少报收入的程度约为小企业的两倍。结果表明，意大利较高的总体逃税率主要由经济活动构成和逃税机会所驱动，而非个体逃税倾向普遍更高或税收道德较弱所致。我们的分配分析揭示，逃税严重扭曲了纵向和横向公平，加剧了两种形式的公平问题，并增加了家庭间税负的不平等。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: Self-employment income tax evasion and inequality

abstract: Little is known about single mothers' labor market outcomes. On the one hand, they might not havethe typical social constraints of married women in traditional patriarchal societies, but on theother hand, they face the same constraints with respect to childcare and childbearing as othermarried mothers. While aggregate data suggests that single mothers’ participationrates are usually higher than those unmarried, we argue that in contrast tomarried women, this realized labor market equilibriummasks potential demand-side discrimination and likely reflects strong supply-side incentives.To uncover potential demand-side discrimination effects, we conduct a correspondencestudy experiment that involves applying to real jobs using fictitious resumes. Weshow that equally qualified single mothers are much less likely to receive interview callbacksthan unmarried women without children, married without children, and married mothers. Forevery interview callback a single mother has to apply to about 30 jobs, whereas an unmarriedwoman receives more than two callbacks for as many job applications.
abstract_zh: 关于单身母亲的劳动力市场结果，我们知之甚少。一方面，她们可能不像传统父权社会中的已婚女性那样受到典型的社会约束；但另一方面，她们在育儿和生育方面面临与其他已婚母亲相同的限制。尽管总体数据显示，单身母亲的劳动参与率通常高于未婚女性，但我们认为，与已婚女性相比，这一已实现的劳动力市场均衡掩盖了潜在的需求侧歧视，并可能反映了强大的供给侧激励。为了揭示潜在的需求侧歧视效应，我们进行了一项通信研究实验，使用虚构简历申请真实职位。结果显示，同等资质的单身母亲获得面试回应的可能性远低于无子女的未婚女性、无子女的已婚女性以及已婚母亲。每获得一次面试回应，单身母亲需申请约30份工作，而未婚女性在相同数量的申请中能收到超过两次回应。

title: Labor market penalty for single mothers

abstract: I study how public sector employment affects aggregate output and employment. Although accounting for approximately 25% of the labour force in modern economies, the macroeconomic effects of public sector employment remain largely underexplored. I build a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with unemployment risk, endogenous job destruction, sluggish vacancy creation, and public sector employment. This is the first HANK model to study this fiscal tool, allowing me to capture key labour dynamics and assess their joint role with unemployment risk in shaping the effectiveness of policy shocks. Calibrated to France, the model shows that public sector employment lowers unemployment and increases aggregate output with multipliers above unity, driven by (i) stronger demand, (ii) labour frictions limiting crowding out, and (iii) reduced unemployment risk –effects that decline in the absence of labour and nominal frictions, and disappear in a representative agent setup. Finally, compared to an increase in benefits, public sector employment is more effective in stimulating economic activity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我研究了公共部门就业如何影响总产出与就业。尽管在现代经济中公共部门就业约占劳动力的25%，但其宏观经济效应在很大程度上仍未得到充分探讨。我构建了一个包含失业风险、内生性岗位破坏、缓慢的空缺创造以及公共部门就业的异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型。这是首个研究这一财政工具的HANK模型，使我能够捕捉关键的劳动力动态，并评估其与失业风险在塑造政策冲击有效性方面的联合作用。以法国为校准对象，模型显示公共部门就业降低了失业率并提高了总产出，乘数大于1，这得益于（i）更强的需求，（ii）限制挤出效应的劳动力摩擦，以及（iii）降低的失业风险——这些效应在缺乏劳动力和名义摩擦时减弱，并在代表性代理人设定中消失。最后，与增加福利相比，公共部门就业在刺激经济活动和福利方面更为有效。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: A heterogeneous agent new Keynesian model of search frictions and public sector employment
title_zh: 搜索摩擦与公共部门就业的异质性主体新凯恩斯模型

abstract: Using a natural experiment in Indonesia, we estimate the separate economic effects of natural resource booms and shared resource revenue. Contrary to Dutch disease concerns, oil and gas booms promote manufacturing growth, and shared revenue does not harm local manufacturing firms. Shared revenue significantly raises local non-oil GDP, but resource booms do not. Supply-side factors help explain the results: shared revenue increases local population and firm entry, while resource booms do not. Oil and gas booms thus benefit local economies largely through shared revenue. Where the revenue is spent matters more for local growth than where the resources are extracted.
abstract_zh: 利用印度尼西亚的一项自然实验，我们分别估算了自然资源繁荣与共享资源收入的经济效应。与“荷兰病”担忧相反，油气繁荣促进了制造业增长，而共享收入并未损害当地制造业企业。共享收入显著提升了当地非石油GDP，但资源繁荣本身并无此效果。供给侧因素有助于解释这些结果：共享收入增加了当地人口和企业进入，而资源繁荣则未产生此类影响。因此，油气繁荣主要通过共享收入惠及当地经济。收入的使用地点对当地增长的影响，比资源开采地点更为重要。
title: Resource booms, revenue sharing, and growth
title_zh: 资源繁荣、收入分享与经济增长

abstract: This paper investigates how local bureaucrats in China respond to minimum targets for air pollution control, which are part of a hybrid incentive contract that simultaneously specifies high-powered incentives for economic growth. Using a novel prefecture-day level dataset on air quality and applying a Regression Discontinuity Design, we find strong evidence that air quality tends to improve when the air quality target is doomed to fail, but deteriorates significantly once early fulfillment of the target is secured. We develop a theoretical model to rationalize these findings and highlight the role of uncertainty faced by local bureaucrats in shaping their responses. Further analyses explore how local economic pressure, the punishment loss for failing to meet the target, regional differences, and political turnovers affect bureaucratic strategic behavior after the target completion status becomes known. This study sheds light on how hybrid incentive contracts function in a multitasking context.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国地方官员如何应对空气质量控制的底线目标，这些目标属于一种混合激励合同的一部分，该合同同时设定了对经济增长的高能激励。利用新颖的地级市日度空气质量数据集，并采用断点回归设计，我们发现强有力的证据表明：当空气质量目标注定无法达成时，空气质量趋于改善；而一旦目标提前实现得到保障，空气质量则显著恶化。我们构建了一个理论模型来解释这些发现，并强调地方官员面临的不确定性在塑造其应对行为中的作用。进一步分析探讨了地方经济压力、未达标惩罚损失、区域差异以及政治更替如何影响目标完成状态明朗后官员的策略性行为。本研究揭示了混合激励合同在多任务情境下的运作机制。

abstract: We propose a new estimator for nonparametric binary choice models that does not impose a parametric structure on either the systematic function of covariates or the distribution of the error term. A key advantage of our approach is its computational scalability in the number of covariates. For instance, even when assuming a normal error distribution as in probit models, commonly used sieves for approximating an unknown function of covariates can lead to a large-dimensional optimization problem when the number of covariates is moderate. Our approach, motivated by kernel methods in machine learning, views certain reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces as special sieve spaces, coupled with spectral cut-off regularization for dimension reduction. We establish the consistency of the proposed estimator and asymptotic normality of the plug-in estimator for weighted average partial derivatives. Simulation studies show that, compared to parametric estimation methods, the proposed method effectively improves finite sample performance in cases of misspecification, and has a rather mild efficiency loss if the model is correctly specified. Using administrative data on the grant decisions of US asylum applications to immigration courts, along with nine case-day variables on weather and pollution, we re-examine the effect of outdoor temperature on court judges' ``mood'', and thus, their grant decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的非参数二元选择模型估计方法，该方法无需对协变量的系统函数或误差项的分布施加参数结构。我们方法的一个关键优势在于其计算可扩展性，能够处理协变量数量较多的情况。例如，即使在如probit模型中假设正态误差分布时，常用的筛法（sieves）在协变量数量适中时，也可能导致高维优化问题。我们的方法受机器学习中的核方法启发，将特定的再生核希尔伯特空间视为特殊筛空间，并结合谱截断正则化进行降维。我们证明了所提估计量的一致性，以及加权平均偏导数插件估计量的渐近正态性。模拟研究表明，与参数估计方法相比，所提方法在模型误设情况下能有效改善有限样本性能，而在模型正确设定时，其效率损失相对较小。利用美国移民法院庇护申请裁决的行政数据，以及九个关于天气和污染的案例日变量，我们重新审视了室外温度对法官“情绪”及其裁决决定的影响。
source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: A kernelization-based approach to nonparametric binary choice models
title_zh: 基于核化的非参数二元选择模型方法
